body.h: Everyone passes four count. At the start Anne and Daniel stand at opposite corners of a square. They face Ben and Clare, who are standing at opposite corners of another square. During the pattern Anne and Daniel walk anticlockwise around their square, and Ben and Clare walk clockwise around their square. When you are at the corner of a square, you pass to the person facing you.
